terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Terms of Service for the AutoMe platform

s1.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By accessing and using AutoMe, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement.

s2.heading: 2. Description of Service
s2.body: AutoMe provides a platform for car dealerships to manage inventory, test drives, and customer interactions. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Service with or without notice.

s3.heading: 3. User Conduct
s3.body: You agree to use the Service only for lawful purposes. You agree not to take any action that might compromise the security of the site, render the site inaccessible to others, or otherwise cause damage to the site or the Content.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for the AutoMe platform

s1.heading: 1. Information We Collect
s1.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create or modify your account, request on-demand services, contact customer support, or otherwise communicate with us.

s2.heading: 2. How We Use Information
s2.body: We may use the information we collect about you to:

items.i1: Provide, maintain, and improve our Services
items.i2: Process transactions and send related information
items.i3: Send administrative messages, customer service responses, and technical notices
items.i4: Communicate with you about products, services, offers, and events

s3.heading: 3. Information Sharing
s3.body: We may share the information we collect about you with third parties such as our partners and service providers who need access to such information to carry out work on our behalf.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Cookie Policy for the AutoMe platform

s1.heading: 1. What are cookies?
s1.body: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the owners of the site.

items.i2: Understand how you use our platform
